title: 3D consistency between views remains challenging
description: The algorithm improves per-view sample quality but struggles with 3D consistency across views, occasionally producing flat or concave 'billboards' despite the convexity loss. The authors suggest possible resolution via supervision with pre-trained depth or normal estimators.
canonical_description: multi-view 3D consistency remains challenging in score distillation

evidence.quote: While we improve the sample quality of each view, 3D consistency between views remains challenging; as a result, despite the  convexity loss, our algorithm occasionally produces flat or concave ``billboards.
